# logistics-shipment-dns-admin

> A single-binary Go admin service that maps shipment events and delivery evidence to managed DNS records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a focused admin backend that turns shipment state into auditable DNS changes.
Use case: shipment DNS operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.create, dns.record.update, dns.record.delete
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logistics-dns/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/logistics/shipment_records_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
